content: We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of the molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon (~10-30 ppm). We need to minimize experiments. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals. But need number of methyl groups, not distinct types. Could be overlapping. Could also use carbon NMR to count number of methyl carbons. That gives count of methyl groups. So use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then parse peaks around 10-30 ppm. Count them. Let's do that.
